boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, officially documented Gonzaga study environments, spanning quiet reading areas, collaborative rooms, lounges, and academic buildings.

cards.title: Bollier’s second-floor window tables
cards.subtitle: Bollier Center for Integrated Science & Engineering
cards.notes: Set up at the second-floor windows for a desk-height workspace and views across the lake; use the nearby outdoor tables only in suitable weather.
cards.short_summary: Second-floor tables pair a focused indoor setup with lake-facing windows.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga identifies the second-floor windows and outdoor tables at the Bollier Center as a student study location.
cards.access_notes: No reservation or public-access terms are stated on the source page.

cards.entity_name: UW-GU Health Partnership Building First-Floor Lounge
cards.title: Study rooms and the first-floor lounge
cards.subtitle: UW-GU Health Partnership Building
cards.notes: Use a study room for a small working session, or settle into the first-floor lounge; bring a plan for the building’s whiteboards and screens.
cards.short_summary: A health-sciences building option with study rooms, screens, whiteboards, and lounge seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga documents study rooms with screens and large whiteboards, plus a first-floor lounge, in the UW-GU Health Partnership Building.
cards.access_notes: No reservation or public-access terms are stated on the source page.

cards.title: Rosauer tables with individual whiteboards
cards.subtitle: Rosauer Center
cards.notes: Choose one of the tables with an attached individual whiteboard when you need to sketch formulas, map an outline, or track problems by hand.
cards.short_summary: A documented table setup with individual whiteboards attached.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga identifies tables with individual whiteboards in the Rosauer Center as a functional study feature.
cards.access_notes: No reservation or public-access terms are stated on the source page.

cards.entity_name: Foley Library Second-Floor Luger Field Overlook
cards.title: Foley’s second-floor Luger Field overlook
cards.subtitle: Foley Center Library
cards.notes: Head to the second floor for a quieter library setting overlooking Luger Field, then use the building’s posted noise-zone signs to match your work style.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor library area with a Luger Field view and a quieter setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga documents the second floor of Foley Library overlooking Luger Field as quiet and suitable for homework.
cards.access_notes: Follow Foley Library’s posted study noise zones and current building hours.

cards.title: Cowles Reading Room for quiet reading
cards.subtitle: Room 312, Foley Center Library
cards.notes: Bring reading or laptop work to this named reading room and keep food and uncovered drinks outside, as required by Foley’s building-use policy.
cards.short_summary: A named Foley reading room with a specific food-and-drink restriction.
cards.evidence_claim: Foley Library’s policy names the third-floor Cowles Reading Room and prohibits food and uncovered drinks there.
cards.access_notes: Food and uncovered drinks are not allowed; observe posted library noise-zone guidance.

cards.title: The Foley Atrium for snack-friendly work
cards.subtitle: Foley Center Library
cards.notes: Use the atrium when you need a shared table and want to keep a covered drink or light snack with you while working through a reading list.
cards.short_summary: An atrium study area where Foley permits covered drinks and light snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Foley Library’s policy lists the Library Atrium among the areas where covered beverages and light snacks or small lunches are allowed.
cards.access_notes: Covered beverages and light snacks or small lunches are permitted; full meals and delivered items are prohibited.

cards.title: Foley’s reservable group study rooms
cards.subtitle: Second floor west, Foley Center Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room through Foley for a focused group session; plan around the one-, two-, or three-hour checkout periods and current Gonzaga affiliation rules.
cards.short_summary: Eleven Foley group-study rooms are available in timed checkout periods.
cards.evidence_claim: Foley Library states that it has 11 group study rooms on second floor west, checked out for one-, two-, or three-hour periods.
cards.access_notes: For current Gonzaga students, faculty, and staff only; check out at the Circulation Desk or use the room-reservation process.

cards.title: Foley’s first-come consultation rooms
cards.subtitle: Main floor, Foley Center Library
cards.notes: Check whether a room is free and use it for a small session; librarians may reserve these consultation rooms, so confirm availability before settling in.
cards.short_summary: Three main-floor rooms are available first-come when not reserved for consultations.
cards.evidence_claim: Foley Library states that three main-floor consultation rooms are first-come, first-served for students when not reserved by librarians.
cards.access_notes: Available to students when not reserved by librarians for consultations.

cards.title: Hemm Den’s student lounge seating
cards.subtitle: Lower Level, John J. Hemmingson Center
cards.notes: Use the tables, couches, and lounge chairs for an informal work block; keep an eye on programming because the room also hosts student events.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level student space with tables, couches, lounge chairs, and a fireplace.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga identifies Hemm Den in the lower level of Hemmingson as a GU-student space that is not bookable.
cards.source_title: John J. Hemmingson Center Guidelines and Procedures
cards.access_notes: The Hemm Den is a GU-student space and is not bookable; activity and noise may be regulated by GUEST.

cards.title: Hughes Hall’s third-floor window corner
cards.subtitle: Third-floor hallway, Hughes Hall
cards.notes: Take a window-side table for individual work or a small group, and use the available whiteboard and outlets to keep materials and devices organized.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor hallway nook with floor-to-ceiling windows, tables, outlets, and a whiteboard.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga documents a third-floor Hughes Hall hallway corner with tables, comfortable chairs, floor-to-ceiling windows, a whiteboard, and outlets.
cards.source_title: Gonzaga Students' Favorite Spots on Campus
cards.access_notes: No reservation or public-access terms are stated on the source page.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named, campus-adjacent destinations on the Boone Avenue, Hamilton Street, Ruby Street, and Sharp Avenue corridors.

cards.title: Indigenous Eats
cards.subtitle: Boone Avenue corridor beside Gonzaga’s east edge
cards.notes: Walk Boone Avenue to the Hamilton intersection for Native American comfort food; use the restaurant’s location page to confirm details before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A Boone Avenue restaurant serving contemporary Native American comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: Indigenous Eats lists its Boone location at 829 E. Boone Ave., Suite E, Spokane, and describes its cuisine as Native American comfort food.
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant; purchase is required for food.

cards.title: Froyo Earth
cards.subtitle: Boone Avenue corridor beside Gonzaga’s east edge
cards.notes: Head along Boone Avenue for frozen yogurt near the Zag Shop; the official location page publishes the Gonzaga-area address and daily hours.
cards.short_summary: A named frozen-yogurt stop on the Boone Avenue commercial strip.
cards.evidence_claim: Froyo Earth lists a Gonzaga-area location at 829 E. Boone Ave., Suite 5, Spokane.
cards.access_notes: Public food business; purchase is required.

cards.title: Otori Sushi
cards.subtitle: Boone Avenue corridor beside Gonzaga’s east edge
cards.notes: Use the eastbound Boone Avenue corridor for a sushi meal at this named storefront; check current ordering and service information before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A named sushi restaurant in the Boone Avenue retail cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s Bulldog Bucks participating-business list identifies Otori Sushi at 829 E. Boone Ave., Suite B, Spokane.
cards.source_title: Bulldog Bucks Welcomed Here | Gonzaga University
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant; purchase is required for food.

cards.title: Domino's
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Street corridor east of campus
cards.notes: Follow Hamilton Street north from campus for pizza carryout or delivery; review the shop’s current ordering options before placing an order.
cards.short_summary: A named pizza shop on Gonzaga’s Hamilton Street edge.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s Bulldog Bucks participating-business list identifies Domino’s at 1320 N. Hamilton St., Spokane.
cards.source_title: Bulldog Bucks Welcomed Here | Gonzaga University
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant; purchase is required for food.

cards.title: Frugals
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Street corridor east of campus
cards.notes: Take the Hamilton Street corridor for a quick-service burger stop; confirm the restaurant’s current menu and operating details before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A named quick-service restaurant on North Hamilton Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s Bulldog Bucks participating-business list identifies Frugals at 1229 N. Hamilton St., Spokane.
cards.source_title: Bulldog Bucks Welcomed Here | Gonzaga University
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant; purchase is required for food.

cards.title: Houston Hot Chicken
cards.subtitle: North Ruby Street corridor west of campus
cards.notes: Walk or ride toward North Ruby Street for chicken sandwiches and sides; verify the restaurant’s current service details before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A named chicken restaurant on the Ruby Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s Bulldog Bucks participating-business list identifies Houston Hot Chicken at 1839 N. Ruby St., Spokane.
cards.source_title: Bulldog Bucks Welcomed Here | Gonzaga University
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant; purchase is required for food.

cards.title: Pita Pit
cards.subtitle: Sharp Avenue corridor north of campus
cards.notes: Use Sharp Avenue for a pita or salad stop just north of campus; check the business directly for current ordering and service information.
cards.short_summary: A named fast-casual restaurant on East Sharp Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s Bulldog Bucks participating-business list identifies Pita Pit at 818 E. Sharp Ave., Spokane.
cards.source_title: Bulldog Bucks Welcomed Here | Gonzaga University
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant; purchase is required for food.

cards.title: Jimmy John's
cards.subtitle: East Mission Avenue corridor near campus
cards.notes: Continue to the Mission Avenue corridor for sandwiches to take along; use the restaurant’s current ordering channel for availability and pickup details.
cards.short_summary: A named sandwich shop on the Mission Avenue approach to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s Bulldog Bucks participating-business list identifies Jimmy John’s at 105 E. Mission Ave., Spokane.
cards.source_title: Bulldog Bucks Welcomed Here | Gonzaga University
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant; purchase is required for food.

cards.title: De Leon's Taco and Bar
cards.subtitle: Boone Avenue corridor near Gonzaga
cards.notes: Use the Boone Avenue corridor for Mexican food near campus; consult the restaurant directly for its current menu, ordering options, and service details.
cards.short_summary: A named Mexican-food restaurant in Gonzaga’s practical walking orbit.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s local dining page includes De Leon’s Taco and Bar among its listed Spokane restaurants and marks it as within walking distance from campus.
cards.access_notes: Public restaurant; purchase is required for food.

cards.title: Osprey Restaurant & Bar
cards.subtitle: North Division Street corridor toward downtown
cards.notes: Follow the Division Street corridor south from campus for a full-service meal; review current menu and access information before planning a visit.
cards.short_summary: A named restaurant on the North Division Street route to downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s Bulldog Bucks participating-business list identifies Osprey Restaurant & Bar at 700 N. Division St., Spokane.
cards.source_title: Bulldog Bucks Welcomed Here | Gonzaga University
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service is available to under-21 visitors; purchase is required for food.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Gonzaga University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend route through Gonzaga’s named campus gathering places, from arrival landmarks to a final classroom-finding stop.

cards.title: Begin at the St. Ignatius Statue
cards.subtitle: Arrival landmark for a campus-orientation loop
cards.notes: Use the statue as a clear meetup point, then orient yourself to nearby walkways before heading toward the main campus gathering areas.
cards.short_summary: A named starting landmark for getting your bearings.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s 2026 Welcome Weekend schedule lists campus tours leaving from the St. Ignatius Statue.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; follow posted campus guidance for any scheduled tour.

cards.title: Meet up on Foley Lawn
cards.subtitle: Open-air gathering stop near the center of campus
cards.notes: Pause here to connect with people from your move-in group, then use the lawn as an easy visual reference for the next campus stop.
cards.short_summary: A named lawn used for Welcome Weekend check-in and activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s 2026 Welcome Weekend schedule places new-student check-in, a block party, and evening activities on Foley Lawn.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor programming and availability vary; consult the current university schedule.

cards.title: Find the resource fair at Herak Quad
cards.subtitle: Campus quad used for orientation gatherings
cards.notes: Take a pass through the quad to identify campus resources and note the paths that connect it to academic and student-life buildings.
cards.short_summary: A named quad used for Gonzaga’s new-student resource fair.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s 2026 Welcome Weekend schedule lists ZagFest, a community resource fair, at Herak Quad.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; event use and access can change with the campus calendar.

cards.title: Get oriented inside Hemmingson
cards.subtitle: Campus hub for dining, meetings, and programs
cards.notes: Walk through the center and locate the welcome desk, meeting areas, and dining levels so the building is easier to use later in the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building with dining and programmed spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga identifies the John J. Hemmingson Center as offering dining options, meeting spaces, and lounge spaces.
cards.source_title: John J. Hemmingson Center | Gonzaga University
cards.access_notes: Academic-year building hours are listed as 7 a.m.–10 p.m. weekdays and 8 a.m.–9 p.m. weekends; seasonal hours differ.

cards.title: Plan a meal stop at The COG
cards.subtitle: Resident dining in the Hemmingson Center
cards.notes: Use this stop to see the dining setup and decide what fits your meal plan or budget before continuing to the evening’s campus programming.
cards.short_summary: The resident dining hall in Hemmingson Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga describes The COG as its resident dining hall, located on the first and second floors of Hemmingson Center.
cards.access_notes: Dining hours and menus are published by location and may change.

cards.title: Join an outdoor activity at Mulligan Field
cards.subtitle: Named field used for Welcome Weekend programming
cards.notes: Keep this field on your mental campus map for large outdoor gatherings, and check the current schedule before making it your evening destination.
cards.short_summary: A named field used for Playfair and class-photo programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s 2026 Welcome Weekend schedule lists Playfair and the Class of 2030 picture at Mulligan Field.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor programming is schedule-dependent; check current event information.

cards.title: See a major campus gathering space
cards.subtitle: Athletic center used for new-student welcome events
cards.notes: Locate the building during daylight, then check Gonzaga’s event information if you plan to return for a welcome program or athletic event.
cards.short_summary: A named athletic center that hosts Welcome Weekend gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s 2026 Welcome Weekend schedule lists Student Welcome Night and the President’s Welcome at McCarthey Athletic Center.
cards.access_notes: Entry requirements vary by event; verify the current event listing before attending.

cards.title: Locate St. Aloysius Church
cards.subtitle: Campus-adjacent church used for academic convocation
cards.notes: Add this landmark to your campus walk so you can find it easily if a university ceremony, service, or other scheduled program brings you here.
cards.short_summary: A named church used for Gonzaga’s academic convocation.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s 2026 Welcome Weekend schedule lists Academic Convocation at St. Aloysius Church.
cards.access_notes: Check the university or parish schedule before attending a service or event.

cards.title: Walk the Johnston Family Mall
cards.subtitle: Processional campus route between orientation stops
cards.notes: Use the mall as a pedestrian connector and look for wayfinding signs as you move between the quad, church, and nearby academic buildings.
cards.short_summary: A named campus mall used for Gonzaga’s welcome procession.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s 2026 Welcome Weekend schedule lists the Welcome Procession on Johnston Family Mall.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor route; allow for temporary closures or event setup.

cards.title: End by finding Crosby Center
cards.subtitle: Academic building used for classroom-finding support
cards.notes: Bring your fall schedule and use the nearby campus paths to practice the first walk to your classrooms before the first full week begins.
cards.short_summary: A named academic destination for classroom-finding programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s 2026 Welcome Weekend schedule lists a Find Your Classrooms program at the Crosby Center steps.
cards.access_notes: Classroom-finding support is schedule-dependent; use the current campus map for self-guided navigation.
